events.title: Bytes Bonus Days for HF's 19th Birthday
events.description: HF turned 19 on April 21 and Omniscient ran a Bytes boost for several days, with extra bytes per post and thread. More birthday-related events are teased.

events.title: Happy 4/20
events.description: Omniscient put each of the six 4/20 leaf awards on sale for $42 for 48 hours, letting members collect the row.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Riddle King awarded to Three for winning 7's Crack the Seed contest. King Decade awarded to bahman2000.

events.title: G0I Vibe Coding Contest - $180 in Prizes
events.description: Horus God is hosting a vibe-coding contest using a designated AI model — winners are judged on functionality, code quality, creativity, and polish. Open submissions until April 30.

events.title: Movie of the Week — Forbidden Fruits
events.description: JoshAllen submitted Forbidden Fruits, calling it a film that doesn't get the credit it deserves and isn't seen enough.
